historical_sample.label: L10
historical_sample.definition: 10 most recent completed regular-season games per player before the cutoff

methodology_override.prior_sportsbook_rule: FanDuel primary; DraftKings fallback only when FanDuel unavailable
methodology_override.current_stage2_instruction: Continue Stage 2 using DraftKings for alternate markets
methodology_override.applied_rule: Use DraftKings alternate lines and prices for Stage 2 because FanDuel data is unavailable and the user explicitly authorized DraftKings.

band_rule.core: American Over odds between -350 and -150 inclusive; among eligible lines choose price numerically closest to -250; ties choose the more negative price.
band_rule.floor: Immediately lower available threshold than Core.
band_rule.ceiling: Immediately higher available threshold than Core, regardless of historical HR.

candidate_narrowing_rule: Carry forward only when a qualifying Core exists and either Floor or Core has historical HR >=7/10; do not use current-week context in Stage 2.
